YouTube Music Desktop with built-in ad blocking, enabled by default.

Download **YouTube-Music-AdBlock-Setup.exe** below for Windows x64. Installing it updates the original YouTube Music Desktop App and preserves its existing profile.

- Network ad filtering with cached filters and offline fallback rules.
- Skipping for playback ads explicitly detected by YouTube's player.
- An on/off switch under **Settings → Playback → Block ads**.
- The installer includes the blocker library and its cosmetic-filter preload.

The playback helper and packaged blocker are checked before publication. The Windows build was also tested locally across multiple songs. YouTube changes may affect blocking; removing every ad is not guaranteed.

This is an unofficial fork of ytmdesktop/ytmdesktop. The installer is unsigned. Linux and macOS installers are not included in this release. See the README and ADBLOCK.md for details and build instructions.
